entries.title: Introduction
entries.text: I'm Avrodeep — a backend engineer who ended up deep in AI, based in Barrackpore near Kolkata. By day I'm an SDE at GenAIus Technology, building the infrastructure behind an AI platform: RAG pipelines, agent workflows, model serving, and the security work that keeps it standing. By night I'm usually reading about reasoning models, or watching anime. On paper: MCA from Jadavpur University, B.Sc. Computer Science from Barrackpore Rastraguru Surendranath College, where I ranked 1st across WBSU. The one-line version: backend engineering meets applied ML, with cybersecurity running through both.

entries.title: What I'm doing now
entries.text: As of September 2026 my main thing is my job at GenAIus: backend infrastructure and multimodal model integration. On the side, an independent research project on reasoning models, and GATE 2028 preparation for an M.Tech in the background. I'm not open to other work opportunities right now and I don't do freelance.

entries.title: My research side project
entries.text: I'm measuring whether reinforcement learning post-training makes test-time search less useful in small language models. If RL sharpens what a model could already find rather than teaching it something new, then best-of-N and tree search should buy less on top of an RL-tuned model than on the base one. Running on free Kaggle dual-T4 GPUs, using procedurally generated puzzles so the task stays contamination-free.

entries.title: GATE and higher studies
entries.text: I qualified GATE in both 2024 and 2025 — just past the cutoff, as practice runs with little preparation, to get familiar with the exam before a serious attempt. I then shifted that serious attempt from 2026 to 2028 so I could get industry experience first, which was the right call. GATE 2028 is the target now, for an M.Tech at an institute with good research scope — the department and its labs matter more to me than the name, and an MS by Research would do the same job if the lab is right. The M.Tech is a means to research: a thesis on reasoning models, and recommendations from faculty who have seen my work, so I can apply abroad for a PhD or a research role afterwards.
aliases: does he want to do a phd

entries.title: Where I want to go
entries.text: Reasoning models and reinforcement learning. I'm curious how language models learn to reason, and whether RL actually teaches them something new or just sharpens what they already knew — put simply, for a fixed budget, is it better to train longer or let the model think longer at answer time? I'd also like to point that at security, where I have production experience and where you can actually check whether a model's reasoning was right, because you know which line was vulnerable. Most reasoning research has a ground-truth problem; security doesn't.

entries.title: MCA at Jadavpur University
entries.text: Master of Computer Applications at Jadavpur University, Kolkata, October 2024 to July 2026, under the CSE department. Graduated First Class with CGPA 8.90 out of 10 (81.76%); semester SGPAs were 8.33, 8.57, 8.68 and 10.00, rising every semester. Alongside coursework I was Placement Coordinator for the batch, presented a seminar on reasoning models, and did my thesis on cross-lingual Bengali idiom matching under Prof. Diganta Saha.

entries.text: B.Sc. Computer Science (Honours) at Barrackpore Rastraguru Surendranath College, under West Bengal State University, October 2021 to August 2024 — a B.Sc., not a BCA. CGPA 9.91 out of 10 (88.65% equivalent) and 1st rank in Computer Science across WBSU; semester SGPAs were 10.00, 10.00, 9.77, 9.77, 10.00 and 10.00. entries.title: WB-JECA 2024 rank
entries.text: Ranked 2nd in WB-JECA 2024 with 101.75 out of 120. It's the state-level entrance exam for MCA admission across West Bengal, covering OOP, data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, DBMS and machine learning.

entries.title: Schooling
entries.text: St. Augustine's Day School, Barrackpore. 91.80% in ICSE (Class 10), then Science with PCMCs — Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Computer Science — and 95.75% in ISC (Class 12). An English-medium ICSE and ISC background is also why I'm comfortable presenting and explaining things on the spot.

entries.title: Placement Coordinator, MCA Jadavpur
entries.text: One of three placement coordinators for the JU MCA 2024-26 batch, with Chitranku Sarkar and Pratik Kotal. The role was mostly documentation and communication: coordinating with recruiters, managing drive logistics, keeping the batch informed, and leaving a roadmap for the juniors. It's also where Let's Connect came from — I built it to fix our own outreach problem.

entries.title: How I work
entries.text: My best hours are 11 PM to 3 AM, with black tea and anime soundtracks. I work on Linux. My instinct on a new problem is to build the measurement rig before the thing itself — most of my projects are evaluation harnesses wearing a project's clothes. I'd rather ship an honest negative result than a flattering one I can't defend, and I document anything that broke in an interesting way.

entries.title: Choices I've made and why
entries.text: I chose MCA over an M.Sc. for employability and engineering-faculty exposure. When two offers landed I took the remote startup role over a larger company's information-security position that needed relocation about 2000 km from home — partly family proximity, partly because a small team means touching the whole stack, which is what happened. GATE 2024 and 2025 I qualified as practice runs; 2026 I skipped deliberately for industry experience. For higher studies I'm going M.Tech first rather than straight to a PhD abroad, so the application has a research thesis and faculty recommendations behind it.

entries.title: Languages I speak
entries.text: English, Bengali and Hindi. English is my working language and I think in it — an ICSE and ISC background means I'm fluent enough to take up oratory and explain things simply on the spot, even in unfamiliar territory. Bengali is my mother tongue. My MCA thesis was on Bengali idioms, partly out of curiosity about whether the idioms I grew up with land the same way in a model.

entries.title: Location and getting in touch
entries.text: Based in Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas, in the Kolkata metropolitan area. I work remotely and commute into Kolkata when needed. The best way to reach me is the Contact Me section on this site or LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/AvrodeepPal. Good things to write about: reasoning models, LLM infrastructure, applied security, or DSA tips if you have good ones.
